source: IDX ESG Disclosure Guide Book (EDGB). Codes and descriptions confirmed live against BANK-BCA's own bilingual index table (p.9/18) and the real value rows (p.6/16-17) — same discipline as `checklists/edgb/environmental.json` and `checklists/edgb/social.json`.

items.description: Board diversity and independence: the composition of the board of directors and commissioners by diversity and independence.
Board meeting attendance: total attendance of directors and commissioners at board meetings.
Chairman/CEO separation policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding separation of the Chairman of the Board and CEO.
Board assessment policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding board of directors and commissioners appraisal.
Board training policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding board of directors and commissioners training and development.
Board selection criteria: whether the bank has special criteria for board appointment and re-election.
Code of ethics and/or anti-corruption policy: whether the bank has a policy regarding ethics and/or anti-corruption.
Fair treatment of shareholders policy: whether the bank has a policy on equitable treatment of shareholders.
Conflict of interest prevention policy: whether the bank has a policy on the obligations of directors/commissioners to prevent conflicts of interest.
